settings.title: Settings

settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name

settings.auth_ns8_provider_invalid: Select an NS8 identity provider and one of its user domains.
settings.auth_wiki_site_missing: The Wiki.js database is not reachable. Make sure Wiki.js is running and try again.

settings.admin_password_saved: A password is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to reset it.
settings.admin_password_length: The password must be 12 to 72 characters long.
settings.admin_password_invalid: The password cannot contain control characters.
